annotations.text:
The flow, left to right: connect, pick what you are shooting, find out whether tonight is even the night, get a plan whose every number shows its reasoning.

Below: the camera itself, focusing on a star, a run in progress, and the same control screen in red for 2am.

Three control states, visible in artboard 5:

Solid border — the app can set it.
Dashed grey — a dial owns it, and it says which.
Dashed amber — writable in principle, inert right now, with the reason.

The strip above them is the camera reporting a change someone made by hand.

Custom is the absence of an intent, not another one — so on screen 2 it sits with the free-text row rather than in the list of subjects. Nothing here is derived, so nothing carries a reason. What a dial owns, it still owns.

Fine focus reaches it from here too. It is a tool, not a step in the astro path.
